$comment: Materials produced by alchemy (elements in, object out). Composition is derived from the alchemy recipe's required elements.

materials.name: Bound Fireball
materials.description: Pyron wrapped in a skin of moving air. Stable right up until it isn't.

materials.name: Healing Draught
materials.description: Life-essence held in solution. Tastes like cut grass and copper.

materials.name: Stone Ward
materials.description: Terran bound with Ferric until it forgets how to be moved.

materials.name: Light Lure
materials.description: A knot of Lumis that things follow. Not always the things you wanted.

materials.name: Shadow Veil
materials.description: Umbral spun thin enough to wear. You are still here; you are simply not worth noticing.

materials.name: Storm Core
materials.description: Zephyr and Pyron forced to share a vessel. They have never once agreed.

materials.name: Golem Core
materials.description: Enough Terran to matter, enough Ferric to obey. Put it in something heavy.

materials.name: Quicksilver
materials.description: Metal that refuses to hold still. Alchemists adore it; their hands do not.

materials.name: Philosopher's Ember
materials.description: The small famous one. Burns without fuel, and has not gone out in four hundred years.

materials.name: Maelstrom Seed
materials.description: A fragment of the storm, folded small. It is patient, and it is counting.
